raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Fixes #62969. With video pruning (EVS / VidCom2) on Qwen3-VL-family models, a chunked-prefill boundary inside a video placeholder gave wrong M-RoPE positions to every following token, and a wrong `mrope_position_delta` for decode. Both model runners now pass each media slice's placeholder offset into `recompute_mrope_positions`, and the 5-channel slices are placed from it.

## Claims

- M-RoPE positions for Qwen3-VL-family models (Qwen3-VL, Qwen3-VL-MoE, Qwen3.5, Cosmos3, Cosmos3-Edge, InternS1-Pro) and Cohere Compass no longer depend on where chunked prefill splits a video or image placeholder. This applies to both Model Runner V1 and V2.
- The same change places 5-channel media from the placeholder offset, not from a `vision_start` search, so it also covers the cases below. The fallback search used by the 4-channel path (Qwen2.5-VL) is unchanged.
  - The outer `<|vision_start|>` that transformers >= 5.10 keeps (#62937).
  - Several media items in one chunk, and the `vision_start | media` split (#48833).

## Validation

**Regression tests.**
- `tests/model_executor/test_qwen3_vl_mrope.py::test_qwen3vl_mrope_evs_chunked_prefill` is CPU-only, with 12 cases: chunk sizes 1, 8, and 4096; with and without outer markers; one or two videos. Placeholders are laid out the way `Qwen3VLMultiModalProcessor` lays them out, and the 5-channel positions are built the way `_get_expanded_positions` builds them. Every chunk's positions and the final delta must equal the expected positions exactly.
- `tests/models/multimodal/generation/test_qwen3_vl.py::test_qwen3_vl_evs_chunked_prefill` runs Qwen3-VL-2B through `vllm_runner` with `video_pruning_rate=0.75` on a 16-frame video. It compares greedy logprobs between prefilling in one 8192-token chunk and in 128-token chunks; the 504-token video placeholder is split 4 times. It runs chunked EVS prefill through both model runners and fails on main (#62937's crash). It also passes on main + #62959, though: on this sample the wrong positions don't change the 2B model's greedy output, so on its own it doesn't detect #62969. The unit test above does.

**Unit test, before and after** (macOS CPU). For the "before" columns, `evs.recompute_mrope_positions` was swapped for the pre-fix version through a small pytest plugin, because the test passes the new argument:

| `evs.py` | single chunk, 1 video | single chunk, 2 videos | chunk size 1 or 8 |
|---|---|---|---|
| main | 1 of 2 pass (no outer markers only) | 0 of 2 | 0 of 8 |
| main + #62959 | 2 of 2 | 0 of 2 | 0 of 8 |
| main + #62959 + #48835 | 2 of 2 | 2 of 2 | 0 of 8 |
| this PR | 2 of 2 | 2 of 2 | 8 of 8 |

Example failure before the fix (#62959 and #48835 applied, chunk size 8, outer markers, one video). The second chunk starts inside frame 0's timestamp tokens and is shifted by 2:

```text
got      [ 0,  1, ...,  7,  8, 11, 12, 13, 14, ...]
expected [ 0,  1, ...,  7,  8,  9, 10, 11, 12, ...]
```

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/model_executor/test_qwen3_vl_mrope.py -q
# 108 passed
```

**End to end** (Colab L4, Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct, bf16, vLLM at fc9b7e654, torch 2.14.0+cu132, transformers 5.20.2):

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `test_qwen3_vl.py` on main | Fails. The one-chunk run crashes in its first prefill step with #62937's `RuntimeError: The expanded size of the tensor (0) must match the existing size (504)`. |
| `test_qwen3_vl.py` on main + #62959 | Passes: the output doesn't show the bug (see the next rows). |
| `test_qwen3_vl.py` on this PR, Model Runner V2 | Passes; one-chunk and chunked outputs are identical. |
| `test_qwen3_vl.py` on this PR, Model Runner V1 | Passes; outputs diverge at token 18 on a near-tie (`' turns'` -1.30 vs `' is'` -1.43), within the top-5 check. |
| Greedy text, 32 tokens, one chunk vs 128-token chunks | Identical, both on main + #62959 and on this PR: *"A young child, wearing glasses, sits on a bed and reads a book. The child is wearing a light blue shirt and pink pants. The child is holding"* |
| `test_qwen2_5_vl.py -k 'evs_functionality and 0.75'` on this PR | 2 passed (the 4-channel path is unchanged). |
| `tests/model_executor/test_qwen3_vl_mrope.py` on this PR | The new cases pass. The existing, unseeded `test_match_qwen3vl_mrope_evs_on` fails intermittently on torch 2.14, **on main as well** (1 of 3 full-file runs; 1 of 20 runs of a single case, versus 2 of 20 with this PR). It passes no offsets, so it runs the unchanged code path. |

**Positions inside the engine.** The greedy text doesn't show the bug, so I compared the M-RoPE positions the engine actually uses. The engine ran in-process with `VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0`, with `recompute_mrope_positions` wrapped to record what each prefill step wrote for its own tokens. Same model, video and settings as above; one 8192-token chunk vs 128-token chunks (Colab G4):

| | Prompt tokens with different positions | Max diff | Decode delta, one chunk / chunked |
|---|---|---|---|
| main + #62959 | 390 of 518, from the first chunk boundary (token 128) on | 7 | -280 / -273 |
| this PR, Model Runner V2 | 0 of 518 | 0 | -280 / -280 |
| this PR, Model Runner V1 | 0 of 518 | 0 | -280 / -280 |

`pre-commit run --files <changed files>` passes.

## Details

**Root cause.** Qwen3-VL's pruned video placeholder is registered with `PromptUpdateDetails.from_seq`, so `is_embed` is `None`. The runner then passes `encoder_output[start_idx:end_idx]`, a positional slice of the placeholder whose t/h/w values are relative to the placeholder's first token. Placing that slice needs two things: the placeholder offset, for the anchor (the position of the token before the placeholder + 1), and the slice start (`max(num_computed_tokens, offset)`). `recompute_mrope_positions` received neither. It inferred them from prompt-side `vision_start` indices and media-token counts, and that breaks inside a placeholder in three ways (traces in #62969):
1. Inside frame 0's video, the anchor was the frame's inner `vision_start` + 1, while the slice values already count frame 0's timestamps and that marker. Positions came out `num_timestamp_tokens + 1` too high.
2. The write offset counted only video tokens, so a split inside timestamps or past frame 0 was written at the wrong index.
3. The prompt lumps every retained video token on frame 0 (`tokens_per_frame=[n, 0, ...]`), while the model spreads them across frames. Past frame 0's video tokens, the "all media tokens seen" early exit fired, and the later frames were never written.

**Change.**
- `recompute_mrope_positions` takes an optional `multimodal_offsets` argument. When it is given and the entries have 5 channels, each slice goes through a small separate loop that anchors at `positions[-1, offset - 1] + 1`, writes at `max(num_computed_tokens, offset)`, and extends the trailing text positions as before.
- `GPUModelRunner._gather_mm_embeddings` (V1) and `MultiModalPruner` (V2) pass the offsets, which they already compute while windowing. In V2, `_num_window_embeds` became `_window_offsets`.
- The protocol and the three in-tree implementations (Qwen3-VL, Qwen2.5-VL, Cohere Compass) take and forward the new keyword.
- Without offsets, or for 4-channel entries, the old code path runs unchanged.

**Compatibility.**
- The new keyword argument defaults to `None` in the protocol and in every in-tree implementation. Both runners now pass it, though, so an out-of-tree model that implements `SupportsMultiModalPruning.recompute_mrope_positions` without it would need to add it.
- The new path calls fewer `nonzero` / `count_nonzero` ops than the old one and keeps the single `.item()` for the delta.

**Not changed.** The V1 drafter pass (`_gather_mm_embeddings(shift_computed_tokens=1)`) still calls the recompute with the unshifted `num_computed_tokens` (#43820). For a draft window that starts inside a placeholder, its write-back is now off by one token, where it used to be wrong in the ways listed above. V2 doesn't recompute in the draft pass.

**Related PRs.** #62959 (mine) fixes #62937 inside the `vision_start` search. In-tree models no longer use that search for 5-channel media, so #62959 is not needed once this lands. #48835 is still relevant for the 4-channel path.

files.patch:
@@ -235,3 +235,124 @@ def test_match_qwen3vl_mrope_evs_on(
     )
 
     assert torch.equal(actual_mrope, expected_mrope_masked)
+
+
+def _video_feature(
+    grid_thw: list[int], offset: int, length: int
+) -> MultiModalFeatureSpec:
+    return MultiModalFeatureSpec(
+        data=MultiModalKwargsItem(
+            {
+                "video_grid_thw": MultiModalFieldElem(
+                    data=torch.tensor(grid_thw),
+                    field=None,  # HACK.
+                ),
+            }
+        ),
+        modality="video",
+        identifier="DUMMY",
+        mm_position=PlaceholderRange(offset=offset, length=length),
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_videos", [1, 2])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("outer_markers", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("chunk_size", [1, 8, 4096])
+def test_qwen3vl_mrope_evs_chunked_prefill(
+    num_videos: int, outer_markers: bool, chunk_size: int
+):
+    """Chunk boundaries inside pruned videos must not change their positions."""
+    random.seed(0)
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    hf_config = DummyConfig()
+    grid_thw = [4, 3, 4]
+    t, h, w = grid_thw
+
+    # Lay out videos the way the processor does: every retained video token on
+    # the first frame, optionally between outer vision start / end tokens.
+    prompt = random.choices(range(1, 100), k=5)
+    videos = []
+    for _ in range(num_videos):
+        video_tokens, pruned_tokens, retention_mask = make_video_embedding(
+            t, h, w, interleave_text_tokens=(3, 6), video_pruning_rate=0.5
+        )
+        video_mrope, _ = Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration._get_mrope_input_positions(
+            input_tokens=video_tokens.tolist(),
+            mm_features=[_video_feature(grid_thw, 0, video_tokens.numel())],
+            config=hf_config,
+        )
+        is_video = pruned_tokens == VIDEO_TOKEN_ID
+        mm_pos = torch.cat(
+            [
+                video_mrope[:, retention_mask],
+                (pruned_tokens == VISION_START_TOKEN_ID)[None],
+                is_video[None],
+            ]
+        ).long()
+
+        placeholder = pruned_tokens[~is_video].tolist()
+        first_frame_start = placeholder.index(VISION_START_TOKEN_ID) + 1
+        placeholder[first_frame_start:first_frame_start] = [VIDEO_TOKEN_ID] * int(
+            is_video.sum()
+        )
+
+        if outer_markers:
+            prompt.append(VISION_START_TOKEN_ID)
+        videos.append((len(prompt), mm_pos))
+        prompt += placeholder
+        if outer_markers:
+            prompt.append(VISION_END_TOKEN_ID)
+        prompt += random.choices(range(1, 100), k=4)
+
+    expected = torch.empty((3, len(prompt)), dtype=torch.long)
+    cursor = next_pos = 0
+    for offset, mm_pos in videos:
+        expected[:, cursor:offset] = torch.arange(offset - cursor) + next_pos
+        end = offset + mm_pos.shape[1]
+        expected[:, offset:end] = mm_pos[:3] + next_pos + offset - cursor
+        cursor, next_pos = end, int(expected[:, offset:end].max()) + 1
+    expected[:, cursor:] = torch.arange(len(prompt) - cursor) + next_pos
+
+    positions, _ = Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration._get_mrope_input_positions(
+        input_tokens=prompt,
+        mm_features=[
+            _video_feature(grid_thw, offset, mm_pos.shape[1])
+            for offset, mm_pos in videos
+        ],
+        config=hf_config,
+    )
+
+    # Mirror the model runner: each chunk gets the slices of the placeholders it
+    # overlaps, and the positions it is run with are the ones written for it.
+    hidden_size = 16
+    chunk_positions = torch.empty_like(expected)
+    for start in range(0, len(prompt), chunk_size):
+        end = min(start + chunk_size, len(prompt))
+        embeddings, offsets = [], []
+        for offset, mm_pos in videos:
+            lo, hi = max(start - offset, 0), min(end - offset, mm_pos.shape[1])
+            if lo < hi:
+                embeddings.append(
+                    torch.cat(
+                        [torch.zeros(hi - lo, hidden_size), mm_pos[:, lo:hi].T.float()],
+                        dim=1,
+                    )
+                )
+                offsets.append(offset)
+
+        _, positions, delta = (
+            Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration._recompute_mrope_positions(
+                input_ids=prompt,
+                multimodal_embeddings=embeddings,
+                mrope_positions=positions,
+                num_computed_tokens=start,
+                vision_start_token_id=hf_config.vision_start_token_id,
+                image_token_id=hf_config.image_token_id,
+                video_token_id=hf_config.video_token_id,
+                multimodal_offsets=offsets,
+            )
+        )
+        chunk_positions[:, start:end] = positions[:, start:end]
+
+    assert torch.equal(chunk_positions, expected)
+    assert delta == int(expected.max()) + 1 - len(prompt)

@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.assets.video import VideoAsset
+
+from ...utils import check_logprobs_close
+
+MODEL = "Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct"
+VIDEO_PROMPT = (
+    "<|im_start|>user\n"
+    "<|vision_start|><|video_pad|><|vision_end|>"
+    "Describe this video.<|im_end|>\n"
+    "<|im_start|>assistant\n"
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.core_model
+def test_qwen3_vl_evs_chunked_prefill(vllm_runner):
+    """Splitting a pruned video across prefill chunks must not change its

Independently checked `75ba108a` on Linux / Python 3.12 / Torch 2.14.0+cpu:

- The prior #62969 witness still gives 41/33/7 wrong-position tokens on `fc9b7e65`; with the new placeholder-offset argument, all three splits give zero errors and delta 1, through both the component and real Qwen3-VL static entry. Unchunked/outside-placeholder controls pass (base: 2 pass/2 fail; head: 4 pass).
- The unmodified `tests/model_executor/test_qwen3_vl_mrope.py` passes all 108 cases, including the 12 new cases; no skips or retries.

Both Python source arms were verified against Git blobs, with the same older official CPU binary (`8e2beaa3`) and dependency environment. This is CPU component/test-module evidence, not an independent weighted-model, engine/GPU or full-CI check. AI assistance was used.
